plan_summary: Six mandatory steps in the first seven days: policies, security awareness, sandbox setup, secure coding, repository workflow and a final assessment.

R1.module_purpose: Prepare an approved, sandboxed development workstation before any engineering work begins.
R1.objective: Set up the approved workstation and sandbox environment and confirm it meets the required configuration.
R1.task_description: Install and configure the approved workstation image and sandbox environment, then verify access.
R1.task_expected_outcome: A working, approved sandbox environment is available for development.
task_completion_criteria: Setup is confirmed with the onboarding lead
R1.checklist_activity: Complete workstation and sandbox setup within 2 days of the joining date.
R1.quiz_question: By when must the workstation and sandbox setup be completed?
quiz_options: Within 2 days of the joining date
Within 7 days of the joining date
R1.quiz_explanation: The approved requirement sets the deadline at 2 days after the joining date.

R2.module_purpose: Learn the secure coding practices required before contributing code.
R2.objective: Apply the required secure coding practices when writing and reviewing code.
R2.task_description: Complete the secure coding training and apply its practices to a small sandbox change.
R2.task_expected_outcome: Secure coding training is complete and its practices are applied in the sandbox.
R2.checklist_activity: Complete secure coding training within 5 days of the joining date.
R2.quiz_question: What must be completed before secure coding training?
quiz_options: Nothing; it can be done first
R2.quiz_explanation: Secure coding builds on the sandbox workstation and security awareness modules.

R3.module_purpose: Demonstrate the approved repository workflow on a real change.
R3.objective: Demonstrate branching, review and merge steps using the approved repository workflow.
R3.task_description: Make a small change following the approved repository workflow from branch to reviewed merge.
R3.task_expected_outcome: A change is merged through the approved workflow with review evidence.
task_completion_criteria: Change reviewed through the approved workflow
R3.checklist_activity: Demonstrate the repository workflow within 6 days of the joining date.
R3.quiz_question: How is the repository workflow requirement satisfied?
quiz_options: By demonstrating it on a reviewed change
R3.quiz_explanation: This requirement must be demonstrated, not only read.

R4.module_purpose: Understand the security awareness expectations that apply from the first days.
R4.objective: Explain the security awareness expectations and how to report a concern.
R4.task_expected_outcome: Security awareness training is complete and recorded.
R4.checklist_activity: Complete security awareness training within 2 days of the joining date.
R4.quiz_question: By when must security awareness training be completed?
quiz_options: Within 2 days of the joining date
R4.quiz_explanation: The approved requirement sets 2 days after the joining date.

R5.module_purpose: Read and acknowledge the required company policies on day one.
R5.objective: Acknowledge the required policies and know where to find them.
R5.task_description: Read the required policies and record your acknowledgement.
R5.checklist_activity: Acknowledge the required policies within 1 day of the joining date.
R5.quiz_question: What is required for the policy acknowledgement?
quiz_options: A recorded acknowledgement within 1 day of joining
A verbal confirmation at any time
R5.quiz_explanation: The acknowledgement must be recorded within 1 day of the joining date.

R6.module_purpose: Confirm readiness after completing all onboarding requirements.
R6.objective: Demonstrate understanding of the completed onboarding requirements.
R6.task_description: Complete the final onboarding assessment after all other modules.
R6.task_expected_outcome: The final assessment is completed and recorded.
R6.checklist_activity: Complete the final assessment within 7 days of the joining date.
R6.quiz_question: When can the final assessment be taken?
quiz_options: After all other onboarding modules are complete
R6.quiz_explanation: The final assessment depends on every other onboarding requirement.
